message: I Love U Indriiii. Thank you for being with me until now. I am really happy to have you in my life. We have shared so many moments together, good days and difficult days, and I am grateful for every moment with you. Thank you for your love, your care, your patience, and for always being there for me. I may not always be perfect, but I will always try to make you happy and take care of you. I hope we can keep walking together, making more memories, and loving each other for a very long time. I love you so much, Indriiii.
